national_priority: Maximize pure national opportunity in Group 2 first, then nationwide national coverage. Require all Group 2 states in the all-states cases.

historical_pool_extensions.reason: The P5 study added these states for coverage and adjacency. They are not in the original Group 2 list.

channel_purity.scope: Every state, for each pure channel N, WH and FI
channel_purity.rule: If any opportunity of a channel in a state is assigned to a pure district of that channel, all of that state's opportunity in that channel must be assigned to pure districts of that channel.
channel_purity.national_exception: A state with no pure national district may allocate national opportunity through WH_PLUS, FI_PLUS or another permitted mixed bundle.
channel_purity.within_channel_district_splits: Allowed subject to the state's district split cap; purity does not require one district per state.
required_checks: Check state shares after every planning stage and after the residual sweep.
Check realized ZIP-channel ownership after repair, overlap handoff and the ZIP sweep.
Check full coverage and report residual opportunity separately; purity alone is not coverage.
Reject a purported compliant result if any selected pure channel also appears in a mixed bundle within the same state.

candidate_operational_settings.source: Historical FI21 P5 study; these settings are recorded for review, not launched.

historical_reference.inspection_scope: Aggregate plan.json shares only; realized ownership and geography provenance were not revalidated.

execution_requirements: Run all four cases in parallel using tools/group2_run.py.
Reconcile any other-first states with national requirements; do not silently remove states or weaken purity to obtain feasibility.

Enforce conditional purity in the planner or provide an explicit equivalent workflow. Existing national-states, force-national and plus-pair flags do not jointly enforce the full rule for N, WH and FI.
Use a fresh output directory and preserve historical results.

Invoke the existing FEFx audit explicitly with separate band-only and band-plus-book-overlap masks.
